t1.RELEASE_NO: key: newest edition (with RELEASE_DATE) selects its rows
t1.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition; the newest carries every period, so only it is read
t1.ROW: key: row order; header and month rows are found by text, not by row number
t1.C01: chart-mort, chart-dev, chart-avg — month label (a footnote over January in the 2025 edition is placed by its neighbours)
t1.C02: chart-mort, chart-dev, chart-avg, kpi:mort, insight:mort_level, insight:mort_spike — first period column (2017-2019 average); periods are found by their header label, not position
t1.C06: chart-mort, chart-dev, chart-avg, kpi:mort, insight:mort_level, insight:mort_season — 2025; a new edition adds a column, read the same way
t2.RELEASE_DATE: key: edition order; the newest edition wins for a month two editions carry
t2.ROW: key: row order; header and month rows are found by text
t2.C02: chart-mig, chart-cum, insight:mig_extreme, insight:mig_total — the earlier year of each edition
t2.C03: chart-mig, chart-cum, kpi:mig, kpi:neg, insight:mig_total, insight:mig_months, insight:mig_extreme — the release's year
releases.RELEASE_NO: text: the latest-edition card (picks the newest edition)
releases.RELEASE_DATE: text: the latest-edition card and the lede (publication date)
releases.TITLE: text: the latest-edition card
releases.HEADLINE: kpi:pop — CBS's one-line summary, shown in the latest-edition card; the total population is parsed from it
releases.PAGE_URL: text: link to the release on cbs.gov.il
releases.REPORT_PDF_URL: text: link to the written report (PDF)
